chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “For the male organ of a boy there is the full blood-money, and for the male organ of an impotent man there is the full blood-money.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the authority conveying this legal ruling
key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: blood-money; legally mandated financial compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: a boy, meaning a male child

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on blood-money for injuring the male organ of a boy or an impotent man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning bodily injury compensation. It establishes that the loss of the male organ of both a boy and an impotent man entails full blood-money, indicating the legal gravity of the injury regardless of current sexual function.
